answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The echo lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
